summary: Persist Sarvam response items keyed by their request, job, upload or dictionary ID when no stable generic ID is present.
reason: Live write-through and sync otherwise skip provider responses that use request_id or job_id instead of a generic id; resource-scoped fallbacks keep unrelated resources from adopting a foreign request ID. Dictionary IDs key both create and later detail responses; matching older name-keyed mirror rows are removed during the next dictionary write.
